a1-107.title: Communicative Challenge: We Take the Pepper
a1-107.scenario: At Mariann's stall Károly asks you (Meg) what you and Anna take. You both want the green pepper, but not the onion.
a1-107.prompt: Tell Károly that you and Anna ask for the green pepper and that you do not ask for the onion.
cues: Say that you (we) ask for the green pepper
Say that you (we) do not ask for the onion
a1-107.target: A zöld paprikát kérjük, a hagymát nem kérjük.
a1-107.english: We'll take the green pepper, we won't take the onion.
a1-107.canDo: I can say what we or they take, with the definite endings, like Mi kérjük a tejet and Ők veszik a kenyeret.

a1-110.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Saturday Shopping
a1-110.scenario: At Mariann's stall you (Meg) are shopping with Anna and Károly. You take the red apples, you buy pears as well, and then you tell Mariann that is all.
a1-110.prompt: Tell Mariann that you all ask for the red apples, that you buy pears too, and that that is all.
cues: Say that you (we) ask for the red apples
Say that you also buy pears
a1-110.target: Kérjük a piros almákat, és körtéket is veszünk. Ennyi.
a1-110.english: We'll take the red apples and we'll buy pears too. That's all.
a1-110.canDo: I can do a whole visit at a market stall, like Mit kérsz? – Kérem a piros almákat. Mást? – Ennyi.

a1-110-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: At the Market
a1-110-consolidation.scenario: At Mariann's stall you (Meg) are shopping with Károly. You take the green pepper, you do not take the onion, and you ask Mariann for the total.
a1-110-consolidation.prompt: Tell Mariann that you and Károly ask for the green pepper and not the onion, then ask how much it is in total.
cues: Say that you (we) ask for the green pepper
Say that you (we) do not ask for the onion
a1-110-consolidation.target: A zöld paprikát kérjük, a hagymát nem kérjük. Mennyi összesen?
a1-110-consolidation.english: We'll take the green pepper, we won't take the onion. How much is it in total?
a1-110-consolidation.canDo: I can take and leave produce at a stall, like Mi kérjük a zöld paprikát, a hagymát nem kérjük.
